Ellie,

Appreciate the level of detail — the attachments were helpful. Short answer: we can support time-limited subcontractor access, but it requires a checklist and a short approval cycle. High level requirements from our side:

1) Signed subcontractor onboarding form (we use a short addendum) and confirmation that LogProx accepts Redwood's DPA terms.
2) A technical data flow diagram showing ingress/egress points and whether any data leaves the EEA during processing.
3) SOC2 Type II snapshot (last 12 months) or equivalent security questionnaire for LogProx.
4) Scoped, ephemeral credentials + IAM policy limiting access to only the specified logs and retention period.
5) A rollback/onshore fallback plan in case of incidents (we typically require an onshore relay option).

Kimberly — can legal confirm whether EdgeLytics' proposed delegation can be covered by our existing DPA addendum or if we need a full DPA amendment? Marissa — can you own the export matrix verification and confirm whether any existing Redwood subprocessors in this path export outside the EEA?

I'll hold approval pending those items; happy to run a quick 30-min call if that's faster.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Sr. Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
